goal: 16:9 horizontal bright-tone promotional image generated for the open-source project Easy Dataset, suitable for GitHub README hero banner, homepage, WeChat official account cover, and technical sharing cover image.

left_column.headline: Easy Dataset
left_column.subhead: One-stop building of LLM fine-tuning, RAG, and evaluation datasets

right_column.centerpiece: Bright SaaS workspace interface floating against a light-colored background, illustrating the process from multi-format document input to high-quality dataset output
right_column.scale: Occupies 60% of the right side, using soft cyan green data lines connecting input, workbench, and output

background.type: Warm White #F8FAFC and very light cyan #EAF7F6 bright background
background.decoration: Light gray grid, soft data flow lines and slightly papery texture, maintaining a fresh white space.

style.aesthetic: Bright, upscale, open-source AI SaaS, clean product website visuals
style.typography: Modern sans-serif, Chinese similar to Source Han Sans, English similar to Inter
style.lighting: soft daylight, clean shadows, subtle cyan glow

footer.placement: Information area in the lower right corner or bottom, using a simple open-source badge style

must_keep: Overall, it has a bright, light color tone.
Easy Dataset title big and clearly readable
Fine-tuning / RAG / Eval three use cases prominent
The visual flow from document input to dataset output must be instantly understandable.
Text must be correct, concise, and readable.
avoid: Third-party brand logo, no real trademarks appearing except for GitHub text
Crowded tables or overly dense small print
